title: AI teacher visual refresh verified
summary: Verified the polished teacher conversation and welcome screens across phone, tablet and desktop widths, with Arabic light/dark and English/French layouts.

changes.detail: Added a centered welcome layout, compact practice/studio shortcuts, emerald header and user bubbles, bordered assistant cards, restrained message typography and a lighter composer.
Visual review caught and corrected encoding in the newly added Arabic and French shortcut labels.

validation.name: Focused ESLint
validation.detail: TeacherUI.tsx, TeacherMessage.tsx and MobileTeacher.tsx passed ESLint.

validation.name: Teacher and history regression tests
validation.detail: 25 tests passed across teacher, teacher-route, teacher-learning-navigation, teacher-lab-interaction, change-history and change-history-interaction.

validation.name: Responsive browser smoke and visual review
validation.detail: Headless Edge: Arabic light/dark and English/French light; 320x568, 390x844, 768x1024, 1440x1000 and 390x480. Composer remained visible; no horizontal overflow or page errors. Settings topic selection and cancel/confirm new conversation passed. Arabic conversation, welcome and dark screenshots reviewed. Authentication was mocked in isolated browser contexts.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Physical devices, native keyboards, live AI responses and lab/studio execution were not tested in this visual-only change. No deployment.
